name: DTR native banner activity
query: SELECT payload->>'banner_id' AS banner_id,payload->>'banner_name' AS banner_name,payload->>'banner_type' AS banner_type,payload->>'host' AS host,CASE WHEN event_type_id='c5b97f1d-55ee-4a95-8521-0ef34db3d339' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS impressions,CASE WHEN event_type_id='3a7590d0-83ca-4a1b-9309-0a40fb612fa0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS clicks,CASE WHEN event_type_id='031358ff-3d5a-4a63-ad73-d7dcfd31e2bc' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS closes,event_time AS event_time FROM events WHERE event_type_id IN ('c5b97f1d-55ee-4a95-8521-0ef34db3d339','3a7590d0-83ca-4a1b-9309-0a40fb612fa0','031358ff-3d5a-4a63-ad73-d7dcfd31e2bc') AND payload->>'banner_id' IN ('b356eb89-d31e-45c2-80e1-ef187bd109cc','d454c38c-3df1-4fac-be6b-2735fdae78ff') ORDER BY event_time DESC,received_at DESC
